scope: Native costs and payout model. No actual 60-fight combat/timing simulation, no real account or server was changed.
assumptions: Daily 3 wins rotate TALENT -> ASCENSION -> EXP over seven Korean days.
Weekly TALENT/ASCENSION/EXP 20 wins each includes daily wins; total is 60, not 81.
The first three material wins are shared per day. EXP does not consume them.
Leftover weekly wins settle on day seven. An alternate model adds three material wins on each EXP day.
MOND books and LIYUE books are separate. MOND highest talent level is 25 (5 base books), LIYUE 60 (12).
Current own-element ASCENSION model uses PYRO. All same-element gem demands share the native formula.
Books/gems are inventory supplies, not cloned separately for four participants.
